class.name: OcgAISViewcontroller
class.brief_description: Auxiliary structure for handling viewer events between GUI and Rendering threads.
class.description: ! Auxiliary structure for handling viewer events between GUI and Rendering threads. ! ! Class implements the following features: ! - Buffers storing the state of user input (mouse, touches and keyboard). ! - Mapping mouse/multi-touch input to View camera manipulations (panning/rotating/zooming). ! - Input events are not applied immediately but queued for separate processing from two working ! threads ! UI thread receiving user input and Rendering thread for OCCT 3D Viewer drawing.

method.name: AIS_ViewController
method.description: Empty constructor.

method.name: InputBuffer
method.description: Return input buffer.

method.name: ChangeInputBuffer
method.description: Return input buffer.

method.name: ViewAnimation
method.description: Return view animation; empty (but not NULL) animation by default.

method.name: SetViewAnimation
method.description: Set view animation to be handled within handleViewRedraw().

method.name: AbortViewAnimation
method.description: Interrupt active view animation.

method.name: ObjectsAnimation
method.description: Return objects animation; empty (but not NULL) animation by default.

method.name: SetObjectsAnimation
method.description: Set object animation to be handled within handleViewRedraw().

method.name: ToPauseObjectsAnimation
method.description: Return TRUE if object animation should be paused on mouse click; FALSE by default.

method.name: SetPauseObjectsAnimation
method.description: Set if object animation should be paused on mouse click.

method.name: IsContinuousRedraw
method.description: Return TRUE if continuous redrawing is enabled; FALSE by default. This option would request a next viewer frame to be completely redrawn right after current frame is finished.

method.name: SetContinuousRedraw
method.description: Enable or disable continuous updates.

method.name: RotationMode
method.description: Return camera rotation mode, AIS_RotationMode_BndBoxActive by default.

method.name: SetRotationMode
method.description: Set camera rotation mode.

method.name: NavigationMode
method.description: Return camera navigation mode; AIS_NavigationMode_Orbit by default.

method.name: SetNavigationMode
method.description: Set camera navigation mode.

method.name: MouseAcceleration
method.description: Return mouse input acceleration ratio in First Person mode; 1.0 by default.

method.name: SetMouseAcceleration
method.description: Set mouse input acceleration ratio.

method.name: OrbitAcceleration
method.description: Return orbit rotation acceleration ratio; 1.0 by default.

method.name: SetOrbitAcceleration
method.description: Set orbit rotation acceleration ratio.

method.name: ToShowPanAnchorPoint
method.description: Return TRUE if panning anchor point within perspective projection should be displayed in 3D Viewer; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetShowPanAnchorPoint
method.description: Set if panning anchor point within perspective projection should be displayed in 3D Viewer.

method.name: ToShowRotateCenter
method.description: Return TRUE if rotation point should be displayed in 3D Viewer; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetShowRotateCenter
method.description: Set if rotation point should be displayed in 3D Viewer.

method.name: ToLockOrbitZUp
method.description: Return TRUE if camera up orientation within AIS_NavigationMode_Orbit rotation mode should be forced Z up; FALSE by default.

method.name: SetLockOrbitZUp
method.description: Set if camera up orientation within AIS_NavigationMode_Orbit rotation mode should be forced Z up.

method.name: ToAllowTouchZRotation
method.description: Return TRUE if z-rotation via two-touches gesture is enabled; FALSE by default.

method.name: SetAllowTouchZRotation
method.description: Set if z-rotation via two-touches gesture is enabled.

method.name: ToAllowRotation
method.description: Return TRUE if camera rotation is allowed; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetAllowRotation
method.description: Set if camera rotation is allowed.

method.name: ToAllowPanning
method.description: Return TRUE if panning is allowed; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetAllowPanning
method.description: Set if panning is allowed.

method.name: ToAllowZooming
method.description: Return TRUE if zooming is allowed; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetAllowZooming
method.description: Set if zooming is allowed.

method.name: ToAllowZFocus
method.description: Return TRUE if ZFocus change is allowed; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetAllowZFocus
method.description: Set if ZFocus change is allowed.

method.name: ToAllowHighlight
method.description: Return TRUE if dynamic highlight on mouse move is allowed; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetAllowHighlight
method.description: Set if dragging object is allowed.

method.name: ToAllowDragging
method.description: Return TRUE if dragging object is allowed; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetAllowDragging
method.description: Set if dynamic highlight on mouse move is allowed.

method.name: ToStickToRayOnZoom
method.description: Return TRUE if picked point should be projected to picking ray on zooming at point; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetStickToRayOnZoom
method.description: Set if picked point should be projected to picking ray on zooming at point.

method.name: ToStickToRayOnRotation
method.description: Return TRUE if picked point should be projected to picking ray on rotating around point; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetStickToRayOnRotation
method.description: Set if picked point should be projected to picking ray on rotating around point.

method.name: ToInvertPitch
method.description: Return TRUE if pitch direction should be inverted while processing Aspect_VKey_NavLookUp/Aspect_VKey_NavLookDown; FALSE by default.

method.name: SetInvertPitch
method.description: Set flag inverting pitch direction.

method.name: WalkSpeedAbsolute
method.description: Return normal walking speed, in m/s; 1.5 by default.

method.name: SetWalkSpeedAbsolute
method.description: Set normal walking speed, in m/s; 1.5 by default.

method.name: WalkSpeedRelative
method.description: Return walking speed relative to scene bounding box; 0.1 by default.

method.name: SetWalkSpeedRelative
method.description: Set walking speed relative to scene bounding box.

method.name: ThrustSpeed
method.description: Return active thrust value; 0.0f by default.

method.name: SetThrustSpeed
method.description: Set active thrust value.

method.name: HasPreviousMoveTo
method.description: Return TRUE if previous position of MoveTo has been defined.

method.name: ResetPreviousMoveTo
method.description: Reset previous position of MoveTo.

method.name: ToDisplayXRAuxDevices
method.description: Return TRUE to display auxiliary tracked XR devices (like tracking stations).

method.name: SetDisplayXRAuxDevices
method.description: Set if auxiliary tracked XR devices should be displayed.

method.name: ToDisplayXRHands
method.description: Return TRUE to display XR hand controllers.

method.name: SetDisplayXRHands
method.description: Set if tracked XR hand controllers should be displayed.

method.name: KeyDown
method.description: Press key. Default implementation updates internal cache.

method.name: KeyUp
method.description: Release key. Default implementation updates internal cache.

method.name: KeyFromAxis
method.description: Simulate key up/down events from axis value. Default implementation updates internal cache.

method.name: FetchNavigationKeys
method.description: Fetch active navigation actions.

method.name: MouseDoubleClickInterval
method.description: Return double click interval in seconds; 0.4 by default.

method.name: SetMouseDoubleClickInterval
method.description: Set double click interval in seconds.

method.name: UpdateZoom
method.description: Update zoom event (e.g. from mouse scroll). This method is expected to be called from UI thread.

method.name: UpdateZRotation
method.description: Update Z rotation event.

method.name: UpdateMouseScroll
method.description: Update mouse scroll event; redirects to UpdateZoom by default. This method is expected to be called from UI thread.

method.name: TouchToleranceScale
method.description: Return scale factor for adjusting tolerances for starting multi-touch gestures; 1.0 by default This scale factor is expected to be computed from touch screen resolution.

method.name: SetTouchToleranceScale
method.description: Set scale factor for adjusting tolerances for starting multi-touch gestures.

method.name: RemoveTouchPoint
method.description: Remove touch point with the given ID. This method is expected to be called from UI thread.

method.name: ProcessExpose
method.description: Handle expose event (window content has been invalidation and should be redrawn). Default implementation does nothing.

method.name: ProcessConfigure
method.description: Handle window resize event. Default implementation does nothing.

method.name: ProcessInput
method.description: Handle window input event immediately. Default implementation does nothing - input events are accumulated in internal buffer until explicit FlushViewEvents() call.

method.name: ProcessFocus
method.description: Handle focus event. Default implementation resets cached input state (pressed keys).

method.name: ProcessClose
method.description: Handle window close event. Default implementation does nothing.

method.name: ResetViewInput
method.description: Reset input state (pressed keys, mouse buttons, etc.) e.g. on window focus loss. This method is expected to be called from UI thread.

method.name: UpdateViewOrientation
method.description: Reset view orientation. This method is expected to be called from UI thread.

method.name: FlushViewEvents
method.description: Update buffer for rendering thread. This method is expected to be called within synchronization barrier between GUI and Rendering threads (e.g. GUI thread should be locked beforehand to avoid data races).

method.name: HandleViewEvents
method.description: Process events within rendering thread.

method.name: OnSelectionChanged
method.description: Callback called by handleMoveTo() on Selection in 3D Viewer. This method is expected to be called from rendering thread.

method.name: OnObjectDragged
method.description: Callback called by handleMoveTo() on dragging object in 3D Viewer. This method is expected to be called from rendering thread.

method.name: OnSubviewChanged
method.description: Callback called by HandleViewEvents() on Selection of another (sub)view. This method is expected to be called from rendering thread.

method.name: PickAxis
method.description: Pick closest point by axis. This method is expected to be called from rendering thread.

method.name: GravityPoint
method.description: Compute rotation gravity center point depending on rotation mode. This method is expected to be called from rendering thread.

method.name: FitAllAuto
method.description: Modify view camera to fit all objects. Default implementation fits either all visible and all selected objects (swapped on each call).

method.name: handleViewOrientationKeys
method.description: Handle hot-keys defining new camera orientation (Aspect_VKey_ViewTop and similar keys). Default implementation starts an animated transaction from the current to the target camera orientation, when specific action key was pressed. This method is expected to be called from rendering thread.

method.name: handleNavigationKeys
method.description: Perform navigation (Aspect_VKey_NavForward and similar keys). This method is expected to be called from rendering thread.

method.name: handleCameraActions
method.description: Perform immediate camera actions (rotate/zoom/pan) on gesture progress. This method is expected to be called from rendering thread.

method.name: handleMoveTo
method.description: Perform moveto/selection/dragging. This method is expected to be called from rendering thread.

method.name: toAskNextFrame
method.description: Return TRUE if another frame should be drawn right after this one.

method.name: setAskNextFrame
method.description: Set if another frame should be drawn right after this one.

method.name: panningAnchorPoint
method.description: Return active panning anchor point.

method.name: setPanningAnchorPoint
method.description: Set active panning anchor point.

method.name: handlePanning
method.description: Handle panning event myGL.Panning.

method.name: handleZRotate
method.description: Handle Z rotation event myGL.ZRotate.

method.name: MinZoomDistance
method.description: Return minimal camera distance for zoom operation.

method.name: SetMinZoomDistance
method.description: Set minimal camera distance for zoom operation.

method.name: handleZFocusScroll
method.description: Handle ZScroll event myGL.ZoomActions. This method is expected to be called from rendering thread.

method.name: handleOrbitRotation
method.description: Handle orbital rotation events myGL.OrbitRotation.

method.name: handleViewRotation
method.description: Handle view direction rotation events myGL.ViewRotation. This method is expected to be called from rendering thread.

method.name: handleViewRedraw
method.description: Handle view redraw. This method is expected to be called from rendering thread.

method.name: handleXRInput
method.description: Perform XR input. This method is expected to be called from rendering thread.

method.name: handleXRTurnPad
method.description: Handle trackpad view turn action.

method.name: handleXRTeleport
method.description: Handle trackpad teleportation action.

method.name: handleXRPicking
method.description: Handle picking on trigger click.

method.name: handleXRHighlight
method.description: Perform dynamic highlighting for active hand.

method.name: handleXRPresentations
method.description: Display auxiliary XR presentations.

method.name: handleXRMoveTo
method.description: Perform picking with/without dynamic highlighting for XR pose.
